question: When screening for a disease, aimed at high-risk groups, looking for disease in its initial stage, is called:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Simple screening -> aimed at high-risk groups -> looking for disease in its initial stage -> precocious -> 95% CHAIN: Selective screening -> targets specific high-risk groups -> increases the likelihood of detecting the disease early -> precocious -> 90% CHAIN: Non-selective screening -> includes the entire population -> may not be as effective in detecting early-stage disease -> late screening -> 95%
analysis: Screening for a disease in its initial stage among high-risk groups is typically referred to as selective screening, aimed at early detection and intervention.
